description: Bounded iterative-deepening expression-tree search returning the closest generated value.

pinned_source.license_note: The repository API reports no license, and this source file has no explicit license notice. The ports are independently written from the documented algorithm and observable behavior.

contract.operation: Use each supplied positive integer at most once in a bottom-up expression tree; combine unused work-list entries with addition, subtraction, multiplication, and exact integer division; return the closest value seen at each iterative-deepening limit.
contract.worklist_order: First operand scans from index zero upward; second operand scans lower indices in ascending order. Used entries are skipped.
contract.operation_rules: Multiplication and division by one are skipped. Zero operands are skipped. Division is accepted only when the first scanned value is divisible by the second before the source's operand reordering; subtraction and division then order operands descending. Each search depth compares only its final newly generated value.
contract.selection_rule: The initial best value is zero; supplied leaves and later search candidates replace it only on a strictly smaller absolute distance to the goal. Search limits run from one through leaf_count-1 and stop at the first exact match.
contract.bounded_portable_profile: At most four leaves of at most 100 keep every intermediate within signed 32-bit range and the complete depth-first search bounded.

output.meaning: Closest value selected by the search; ties retain the first value encountered. The upstream stdout expression is represented by its final evaluated value.
